verdict.overall: The biggest movers since Sunday are NVDA (down 9.5% ahead of its 11-17 earnings), and ZETA, AMAT and AVGO (all up over 10%, with resistance ceilings climbing sharply alongside them). GOOGL, SPY and QQQ remain the calmest, most stable setups for range-based swing trades over the next month, with neutral readings holding steady. TSLA, PLTR, ZETA and APP look weakest, having flipped toward opposing gravity as price pushed into overhead resistance, so confidence in quieter index-like names is rising while confidence in chasing the recent high-flyers is falling.

tickers.TSLA: Since Sunday: weaker. Price jumped 6% to $379.78 but the three nearest expiries flipped from neutral to opposing, meaning resistance is building overhead. Floor sits near $350, ceiling near $400 into early December.
tickers.PLTR: Since Sunday: weaker. Price rose 5.3% to $168.82, but the nearest expiry flipped from neutral to opposing as its ceiling moved up to $170, just above today's price. Floor sits at $150, suggesting resistance is capping the bounce.
tickers.NVDA: Since Sunday: little changed in rating, though price fell 9.5% to $168.89. All four expiries stay neutral, with magnets and ceilings drifting lower with the stock. Earnings land 11-17, adding event risk, and options here are pricey with a bearish trend.
tickers.ZETA: Since Sunday: weaker. Price surged 13% to $35.07, but the two nearest expiries flipped from neutral to opposing and their ceilings jumped to $36 and $40, showing resistance building well above price. Options are pricey, so moves could be choppy despite the uptrend.
tickers.AMAT: Since Sunday: little changed in rating but levels shifted a lot - price jumped 12% to $372.53, with the nearest floor rising from $305 to $365, right under price, and the 12-04 reading flipping to opposing. Earnings land 11-12, just before the first expiry, adding risk; options are pricey near-term.
tickers.AVGO: Since Sunday: little changed in rating but levels shifted - price rose 13% to $331.98, with the nearest floor jumping from $250 to $330, close under price, and the 12-04 reading flipping to opposing. Ceilings also moved higher, toward $380 near-term, as the range widened with the rally.
tickers.GOOGL: Since Sunday: little changed. Price edged up 0.9% to $287.38 and all four expiries stay neutral, with floors and ceilings fairly steady between $270 and $330. A calm, well-balanced setup for range trading, though the trend remains down.
tickers.APP: Since Sunday: weaker, even though price only rose 1.1% to $395.51. The nearest magnet jumped from $285 to $355, and the 11-27 floor rose to $375 with its ceiling to $450. Three of four expiries stay opposing, and the stock is overbought, so caution applies to further strength.
tickers.BE: Since Sunday: little changed in rating (all neutral), but price rose 7% to $185.42, with the nearest magnet rising to $190, floor to $175 and ceiling to $200. Options here are pricey and the trend remains down, so the range could still break lower.
tickers.SPY: Since Sunday: little changed. Price rose 2% to $749.92 and all expiries stay neutral. Nearest floor $745 (£106.03), ceiling $776 (£110.44), magnet $753 (£107.17) - a broad, calm range despite the down trend.
tickers.QQQ: Since Sunday: little changed. Price rose 2.8% to $674.76, staying neutral throughout. Nearest floor $650 (£74.33), ceiling $700 (£77.73), magnet $685 (£76.71, rough since ISUS only partly tracks the Nasdaq) - a stable short-term range despite the down trend.
